q1: SELECT beer, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_gap, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves WHERE beer IN (SELECT s.beer FROM serves AS s, frequents AS f WHERE s.bar = f.bar AND f.drinker LIKE 'B%' GROUP BY s.beer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.bar) >= 2) GROUP BY beer ORDER BY beer
q2: WITH FrequentedBars AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.bar FROM frequents AS f JOIN drinker AS d ON f.drinker = d.name WHERE d.name LIKE 'B%'), BeerInFrequentedBars AS (SELECT s.beer, s.price FROM serves AS s WHERE s.bar IN (SELECT bar FROM FrequentedBars)), BeerStats AS (SELECT beer, MAX(price) - MIN(price) AS price_gap, AVG(price) AS avg_price, COUNT(DISTINCT bar) AS bar_count FROM serves GROUP BY beer HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT bar) >= 2) SELECT bs.beer, bs.price_gap, bs.avg_price FROM BeerStats AS bs JOIN BeerInFrequentedBars AS bifb ON bs.beer = bifb.beer ORDER BY bs.beer
